title: A passionate pilgrim
html_source:
A twenty poem anthology brought out by William Jaggard approx. 1598. It is ‘by’ William Shakespeare although only a handful of poems are thought to be written by him.

There are two levels then to this allusion – Stephen continues his argument about the William- Ann relationship and Joyce confronts his relationship with the ‘greatest writer ever’.
